metadata.title: PRÉCIS DE L'ART DE LA TEINTURE

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and thin, horizontal serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (such as Didot or Bodoni), which was the standard for formal French printing in the mid-19th century.
